messages:
karen-sales: Need quick help — NovaHealth running a live customer run in ~25m (ap-southeast1). They're hitting admission drops and some 504s. Request temporary quota lift for this session: qps from 40 -> 120, queue cap from 40 -> 300, TTL 75m. Paid pilot, card on file. Need ops + support signoff please.
maria-support: On it. Please paste project/account id and confirm billing arrangement. Any error snippets from the customer?
karen-sales: Project: novahealth-live-demo-apac, account: acct_NH_live_01. Card on file, sales ok to underwrite up to $600/hr for the session. Customer seeing 4-7s tail latencies and intermittent timeouts.
sam-eng-sre: I'm oncall. ap-southeast1 inference queue length spiked to 260, 95th enqueue latency ~270ms, admission drop rate ~22% over 10m. We're also running a rolling kernel patch that temporarily reduced per-AZ capacity by ~10%.
liam-ml-infra: Routing to ap-southeast2 is possible but adds ~100ms to RTT. Can also suggest redwood-lite-v1 fallback or reduce max_tokens per request (300->200) to cut GPU time.
autoscaler-bot: ALERT: ap-southeast1 pool at 98/100 GPUs, queue depth 260, scaling cooldown in 9m.
jess-finance: Finance can place a billing hold for up to $600/hr for this session pending ticket. Need ops confirmation to proceed.
maria-support: Creating ticket and billing hold now. SUP-2026-428 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-2026-428. Noting $600/hr cap.
ops-oncall-jordan: I can approve a temporary bridge for 75m if we apply safeguards: 1) set per-request max_tokens=200, 2) set fallback_model=redwood-lite-v1 for overflow, 3) make the quota bump TTL=75m and auto-revoke. If finance acked, I'll greenlight.
sam-eng-sre: Proposed change for acct_NH_live_01: qps=120, queue_limit=300, max_tokens_per_req=200, fallback_model=redwood-lite-v1, ttl_mins=75. I will push and watch.
sam-eng-sre: Applying change now. Command: ```
curl -s -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/quota \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"account":"acct_NH_live_01","qps":120,"queue_limit":300,"max_tokens_per_req":200,"fallback_model":"redwood-lite-v1","ttl_mins":75}'
```
sam-eng-sre: Metrics after change: enqueue latency down ~65%, admission drops <3% within 2m. Queue length trending down.
ops-oncall-jordan: Patch live. Monitoring for cross-tenant impact — rollback if we see error or latency spike.
karen-sales: Customer back on the call, says responsiveness much improved and demo continuing. Will relay update. Thanks team :tada: 
maria-support: Please add follow-ups to SUP-2026-428: (1) postmortem if any customer-visible impact; (2) recommend apac capacity bump or Dedicated for NovaHealth; (3) billing reconciliation. I'll keep ticket open for 24h verification.
liam-ml-infra: Long-term rec: introduce paid-trial soft-reservations per region and an automated short-lived quota workflow so sales/support don't need manual ops intervention. Filed infra RFC draft.
ops-oncall-jordan: Leaving temporary bridge active for 75m TTL; it will auto-revoke. If extension needed, update SUP-2026-428 with justification and finance ack.
karen-sales: Will do. Closing the loop with customer now.
